short_description:
The GTA 6 ghost ship easter egg: start at the St. Lucia Lighthouse on Little Hardin Island (Leonard County, the northeast of the map) at night. Climb the lighthouse, find the keeper's journal in the ruined house nearby, then take a boat east of the lighthouse around 1:30 AM in-game. Dive to the wreck for the Cursed Knife. Guides differ on the start time (after 10 PM) and the house's exact position. No story spoilers.

📍 Map Spot #11 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Sources: Dexerto, VICE, TechWiser, TheClick, gta6.house.

Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides).

short_es.title: El BARCO FANTASMA de GTA 6 sale a la 1:30 AM 👻 #GTA6 #Shorts
short_es.description:
El barco fantasma de GTA 6: empieza de noche en el faro de St. Lucia, en Little Hardin Island (Leonard County). Sube al faro, busca el diario del farero y sal en barco al este del faro hacia la 1:30 de la madrugada. Bucea hasta el naufragio por el Cuchillo Maldito. Fuentes: Dexerto, VICE, TechWiser, TheClick.
